WITH same_stores AS (
  SELECT StoreKey FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
  INTERSECT
  SELECT StoreKey FROM retail.FactSales WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2008
)
SELECT (
  sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2009 AND StoreKey IN same_stores)
  - sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2008 AND StoreKey IN same_stores)
) * 100.0 / nullif(sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2008 AND StoreKey IN same_stores), 0) AS same_store_sales_growth_pct
FROM retail.FactSales
